message: Add active header button highlights for Settings and Add Deadline (v1.8.27)
changelog: Add Custom Deadline Modal in Extension (src/popup/index.html, src/popup/modules/navigation.ts, src/popup/modules/overlayController.ts, src/popup/popupDraft.ts): Converted #view-add into a floating #modal-add-task dialog matching Companion PWA, opening over the currently active tab (Calendar, Deadlines, Marks, Courses, Payments, or Settings), keeping #btn-add-modal highlighted while open, supporting Escape/backdrop dismissal, and preserving typed draft fields plus underlying tab state across popup closes.

Unpaid Fees Banner Width & Wrapping (src/popup/styles/12-payments.css, src/mobile/styles/11-payments.css): Aligned #deadlines-payments-strip to the 14px horizontal inset of .controls-bar and task cards in the extension Deadlines tab, and switched .payments-strip-text to flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; display: block; so fee summary text wraps cleanly alongside the Payments button.
